income.title.description: Heading of the section of the income from the supporter plans on the finances page, the public page of the running costs, and the costs screen.

income.public.no_balance.defaultMessage: The balance is not published, since this server does not publish its costs.
income.public.no_balance.description: Note in the income section of the public page of the running costs when the server publishes its income but not its costs, so the balance is not published.

income.loading.description: Accessible name of the progress indicator while the income totals load.

income.failed.description: Heading shown in place of the income totals when they could not be loaded.

income.retry.description: Button that tries again to load the income totals after a failure.

income.totals.caption.description: Accessible caption of the table of the income totals: the chosen period kind and the way payments are counted.

income.totals.gross.description: Column header and term of what the supporters paid before the payment provider's fees, on the costs screen only.

income.totals.fee.description: Column header and term of the payment provider's fees, on the costs screen only.

income.totals.net.description: Column header and term of the income after the payment provider's fees and the refunds.

income.totals.balance.description: Column header of the balance: the income less the costs of the same period and currency.

income.plans.title.description: Heading of the number of members of each supporter plan now, next to the income totals.

income.plans.description.defaultMessage: The members now, not in each period. The amounts of each plan are not shown.
income.plans.description.description: Explanation of the number of members of each supporter plan next to the income totals.

income.plans.empty.description: What the list of the members of each plan says when no plan has members.

income.plans.members.description: The number of members of a supporter plan now.

income.rules.title.description: Heading of the rules that date and place the payments in the income totals.

income.rules.net.defaultMessage: The income is what the supporters paid, less the payment provider's fees. A refund or a chargeback is taken off in the period it happens.
income.rules.net.description: Rule of the income totals: what the income is.

income.rules.provider.defaultMessage: {provider} dates its payments in the {timeZone} time zone.
income.rules.provider.description: Rule of the income totals: the time zone in which a payment provider (such as stripe) dates its money movements (UTC, Asia/Tokyo).

income.rules.amortized.defaultMessage: A payment for more than {days} days, such as a yearly plan, is spread by day over the days it pays for. Its refund takes off the days before it on the day of the refund, and cancels the days after it. Other payments count on their dates.
income.rules.amortized.description: Rule of the spread income totals. {days} is the number of days a payment must cover to be spread, such as 31.

income.rules.cash.defaultMessage: Every payment, refund, and fee counts on its date.
income.rules.cash.description: Rule of the income totals on the payment date.

income.rules.balance.defaultMessage: The balance is the income less the costs of each currency, both counted the same way. Currencies are never converted.
income.rules.balance.description: Rule of the income totals: what the balance is.

income.totals.by_source.description: Column header of the administrators' income totals: the income after fees of the subscriptions, of the tips, and of the other money of the provider's account.

income.source.subscription.description: Source of the income: the subscriptions to the supporter plans.

income.source.one_time.description: Source of the income: the tips, one-time payments to the server's operation with nothing in return.

income.source.unknown.description: Source of the income: money of the payment provider's account that is neither a subscription nor a tip, such as a payment taken outside this server or a fee of no subscription.

income.source.net.description: A line of the income of one source in a period. source is the source, such as Tips; net is the formatted income after fees of each currency.

income.plans.tips.description: The last row of the members of each plan while the server takes tips: the totals include them.

income.plans.tips.note.defaultMessage: Included in the totals, without their number
income.plans.tips.note.description: Beside the row of the tips in the members of each plan: their number and amount are never shown.

income.rules.tips.defaultMessage: A tip counts in full on the date it is paid. Its refund or chargeback is taken off in the period it happens.
income.rules.tips.description: Rule of the income totals while the server takes tips.
